description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveConfigurationServiceTest' for the 'LeaveConfigurationService' in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It includes test cases for methods like getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, getWorkScheduleImplementation, includePendingLeaveInBalance, and others, mainly focusing on configuration-related functionalities.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various configuration retrieval and setting methods of the LeaveConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave entitlement consumption strategy configuration value.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of work schedule implementation configuration value.

methods.name: testIncludePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Tests includePendingLeaveInBalance method for different configuration values.

methods.name: getIncludePendingLeaveInBalanceDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for includePendingLeaveInBalance method.

methods.description: Tests setting the leave period defined configuration value.

methods.description: Tests retrieval of whether the leave period is defined.
